answer: Jury of 5. Anyone who diverges by more than 1 grade slashes the payout. A panel with 2 seats on one subnet is void, no payment, no appeal. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a copied answer dies on its second send. Our shop spends 20 minutes reading the rules once. A farm writes 400 answers, needs 400 nonces and 400 diverse panels, and one packed panel voids the batch. We haul timber and shale; a voided batch moves nothing, and the ripple hits every seat in it.
